questions.q: Which module system uses require() to import dependencies?
questions.explanation: CommonJS loads modules synchronously through the require() function.

questions.q: Which file does npm create by default when you run npm init?
questions.explanation: npm init writes package.json, which describes the project and its dependencies.

questions.q: Which core Node.js module provides utilities for working with file and directory paths?
questions.explanation: The path module joins, resolves, and parses file-system paths safely.

questions.q: Which popular package is commonly used to build HTTP servers in Node.js?
questions.explanation: Express is a minimal web framework built on top of Node.js HTTP primitives.
